comment: Hand-crafted: the Doctor query of gh dojo doctor. The data shape follows the GraphQL schema (viewer, repository); X-OAuth-Scopes is the header GitHub sends for classic tokens, which recording does not keep. No X-OAuth-Scopes header (a fine-grained token); the second repository does not resolve (NOT_FOUND error, message as GitHub words it), the third has issues disabled. The labels fields (dojoConfig: the kanban preset's area_prefix "area:", no types) are the real API's answer for Trum-ok/gh-dojo, saved by hand.
